svg.aria-label: Mains wiring for the kandil lamp. A 3-pin 6 amp plug has live, neutral and earth terminals. Inside a closed plastic box, the live core goes through a T2A slow-blow fuse in an inline holder to the relay's COM terminal. The relay's NO terminal carries switched live out of the box to the L contact of a B22 bulb holder with a 60 watt incandescent bulb. The holder's N contact returns on the neutral core, which goes straight back to the plug through a lever connector in the box. The earth core goes straight through another lever connector to the holder's earth screw if it has one; a plastic B22 holder has none. The relay's NC terminal is left empty. One corner of the box is the low-voltage corner with the ESP32 and switch, kept away from every mains wire.
